verdict.rationale: Superhuman is a proprietary client layered on top of Gmail/Outlook accounts; the evidence pack contains no mention of IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access, standards-based export, or any data-portability guarantee — only MCP integration for AI assistants and account switching between Gmail/Outlook. No documentation addresses protocol-level openness or export, so switchers have no evidence their mail stays reachable outside Superhuman's own app.
